scope: Independent pre-ranking instrument and existing evaluation-runner review. Read questions, assertions, literal references and relevant complete passages. No Corpus.search or ranking results, embeddings, provider/model calls, remote API calls, source edits or rubric edits.

resolved_before_rankings.issue: The original assertion required selecting displayed input/output fields although the question only asked selecting recordings.
resolved_before_rankings.resolution: Removed the unasked display-field requirement; selecting traces and adding them to the queue remains required.

resolved_before_rankings.issue: The original assertion required a Weave Model even though the question asks generically for versioned application variants.
resolved_before_rankings.resolution: Accept a documented versioning approach, such as a Weave Model; no representation or reference-page exclusivity.

reference_limits: The relevance set is curated and nonexhaustive; unlisted passages are not automatically irrelevant. Preserve original scores if later manual review discovers alternatives.
Alternative listed passages satisfy one nugget; they are not additional required reads.
Nine information needs each appear twice. Query variants are correlated; report family as well as query results, without treating 18 queries as 18 independent needs.

Primary text/section identity is the retrieval target. A located passage/snippet is navigation, not proof that the agent read or correctly used its evidence. Page context and additional navigation can help later reads beyond the single-query ceiling.
Four questions cannot attain full curated coverage at six results with two sections per page. Keep this limit unchanged across arms and report the ceilings below.

The add_cost API passage contains unrelated annotation prose, and the cost cookbook prose has an include_cost typo; selected claims follow the supported per-token arguments and consistent include_costs code/API.

live_selection.rule: In category order plain_language, exact_api, workflow, select the first two cases by id whose group_id has not already been selected across earlier categories. Selection is frozen before retrieval outcomes.

harness_review.description: Six frozen questions, baseline versus one globally selected alternative; one fresh Session per case-arm cell. Alternate baseline-first/candidate-first across pairs. This is 12 agent runs, not 12 provider requests.
harness_review.selection_rule: Highest mean nugget recall@6, then all-nugget coverage, then contextual lexical. No per-case winner selection or post-ranking query/reference changes.
fixed_controls: same candidate, citation, verifier and recovery policies
harness_review.budget: One shared outer model_budget(5); nested limits must remain5. Conservative reservations and zero hidden provider retries. Stop new cells after incomplete/provider/judge/budget failure; preserve partial pairs and all returned usage. The $5 estimate excludes Signals, unreturned charges and any separately paid embedding service.
harness_review.provider_call_ceiling: At most14 runtime provider invocations plus1 external judge per cell under current limits, or180 for12 cells; the spend budget normally stops earlier. No added model retries beyond the existing bounded planner retry.
harness_review.sequential_receipts: RUN_DIRECTORY is module-global; execute cells sequentially with unique run directories. Do not run concurrent arm evaluations through that global.
harness_review.identity: Record retrieval arm separately from verify_mode, frozen source/config/embedding revision, stable case/trial pairing, distinct prediction UUIDs, and explicit arm in cell identity.
harness_review.judge_boundary: Resolve all frozen reference alternatives for the existing judge; send only question/history to the agent. Judge payload must omit arm labels and retrieval scores.
harness_review.accounting: Reuse aggregate_records and reconcile_budget_usage, including unsuccessful calls and usage lacking completed receipts. Report paired complete cases separately and do not make incomplete arms appear cheaper.
harness_review.timing: Prepare indexes before agent timing and record preparation separately. Alternate cache order; one sample per cell does not establish reliable latency or quality superiority.
harness_review.weave_boundary: Use existing Evaluation/Agent tracing; verify actual remote rows and leaf spans separately from parent summary synchronization. A matching evaluation parent does not prove all child rows were delivered.

recommendation: Approved to freeze and run the predeclared offline comparison, followed by the bounded paired live check if authorized by the protocol. Retain all disclosed limitations; do not equate retrieval improvement with answer-quality improvement.
